- [USER] User noticed that some comic book series have started incorporating real-world issues into their stories.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Comic book series have historically addressed real-world issues, such as war, terrorism, and political corruption.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Others argue that comic books should be an escape from reality, and too many real-world issues could detract from entertainment value.
